# Contributing

We'd love your help documenting abandoned IoT device protocols!

## Document a Device

1. Follow our [methodology guide](../getting-started/methodology.md)
2. Use the [device template](../devices/_template.md)
3. Submit a PR or open a "New Device" issue

## Improve Existing Docs

Found an error? PRs welcome!

## Submission Guidelines

- Use the device documentation template for consistency
- Include raw data (hex dumps, packet captures) where possible
- Credit prior research you're building on
- Partial documentation is absolutely welcome
